Scientific benchmark performance and human-expert review have not been established.
Representative proteomics studies, complex blocking structures, continuous covariates, interactions, paired analyses, and large matrices have not been runtime-evaluated.

Only exact R 4.4.1 and limma 3.60.6 are accepted; other runtime combinations remain unverified.

decision_sequence.applies_when: Protein-level identity or the already-normalized log2 abundance declaration is absent or ambiguous.
decision_sequence.question: Are these finite values already normalized log2 protein-level abundances with documented producer provenance?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Confirm the exact producer scale and protein-level boundary; otherwise stop and route to upstream QC or preparation.

decision_sequence.applies_when: The single numerator-minus-denominator condition contrast is absent or ambiguous.
decision_sequence.question: Which one prespecified condition level is the numerator and which is the denominator?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Declare one primary numerator-minus-denominator contrast before viewing differential results.

decision_sequence.applies_when: The categorical adjustment columns are absent, ambiguous, or not prespecified.
decision_sequence.question: Which prespecified categorical metadata columns belong in this design?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Include only justified categorical adjustment terms and stop when they make the design rank-deficient or saturated.
